# Stellar Welding
> Welding and metal fabrication services in Oregon City, Oregon and the Portland metro. Oregon CCB #259624. (503) 765-6613.

## Services
- [Mobile Welding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/mobile-welding/): on-site repair for equipment, gates, structures. $95–$150/hr plus travel
- [Gates & Metal Fencing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/gates-fencing/): driveway gates, ranch gates, ornamental fence. $1,200–$6,000
- [Handrails & Guardrails](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/railings/): interior and exterior railings to code. $85–$220 per linear foot
- [Structural Welding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/structural-welding/): beams, columns, connections, repairs. Quoted per project
- [Equipment & Trailer Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/equipment-repair/): trailers, buckets, implements, hitches, frames. $150–$900
- [Custom Fabrication](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/custom-fabrication/): one-off brackets, frames, racks, mounts. Quoted from drawings
- [Metal Stairs](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/stair-fabrication/): industrial and residential steel stairs. $2,500–$9,000
- [Aluminum Welding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/aluminum-welding/): boats, trailers, ramps, marine repair. $110–$170/hr
- [Stainless Fabrication](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/stainless-welding/): food service, marine, sanitary work. $110–$180/hr
- [Ornamental Ironwork](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/ornamental-ironwork/): decorative panels, brackets, signs, screens. $400–$3,000
- [Farm & Ranch Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/farm-repair/): implements, gates, corrals, feeders. $95–$150/hr
- [Truck & Rack Fabrication](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/truck-accessories/): headache racks, flat beds, ladder racks, bumpers. $800–$4,500
- [Beam & Post Repair](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/beam-repair/): reinforcement, splices, column repair. Quoted on site
- [Weld Repair Assessment](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/stellar-welding-llc/services/welding-inspection/): evaluating failed welds and the right fix. $95–$250
